_comment: Git safety rules for Claude Code. Blocks dangerous operations, warns on risky ones.

deny.message: Push to main is blocked. main = PROD. Use a feature branch → PR → merge.
Push to main is blocked. main = PROD. Use a feature branch → PR → merge.
Push to master is blocked. master = PROD. Use a feature branch → PR → merge.
Push to master is blocked. master = PROD. Use a feature branch → PR → merge.
git reset --hard is BLOCKED. It wipes ALL uncommitted changes. Use 'git revert <sha>' or 'git restore --source=<sha> -- <path>' instead.

warn.message: Force push can overwrite others' commits. Prefer --force-with-lease.
--no-verify bypasses pre-commit hooks. Fix the underlying issue instead.
git checkout --theirs blindly accepts their version. Review conflicts manually.
git checkout --ours blindly accepts your version. Review conflicts manually.
git checkout -- <files> discards uncommitted changes permanently. Commit or stash first.
git clean -f permanently deletes untracked files. Use -n (dry-run) first.
git stash drop permanently deletes stashed changes. Consider 'git stash list' first.
